about:
# Start Practice Button

## This mod adds buttons to trigger the level immediately in practice.


- The Level start menu

![See the image on github](https://github.com/memr404/StartPractice/blob/main/preview/level_button.png?raw=true)


- Launching a level in the editor immediately in practice

![See the image on github](https://github.com/memr404/StartPractice/blob/main/preview/editor_button.png?raw=true)


- Only the practice start button

![See the image on github](https://github.com/memr404/StartPractice/blob/main/preview/only_level.png?raw=true)

![See the image on github](https://github.com/memr404/StartPractice/blob/main/preview/only_editor.png?raw=true)


- A button to restart the level immediately in practice

![See the image on github](https://github.com/memr404/StartPractice/blob/main/preview/end.png?raw=true)
